questions.chapterTitle: Process Safety Management and Management of Change
questions.stem: A process hazard analysis team receives incomplete chemical reactivity data and outdated piping drawings but is told to complete the review on schedule. What is the best response?
options: Resolve or explicitly control the critical information gaps before relying on the analysis, and document validated process safety information
Complete the analysis using assumptions that are not identified in the record
Treat operator memory as a permanent substitute for current drawings
Remove reactivity scenarios so the review can finish on time
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: A defensible PHA depends on accurate, complete process safety information. Material gaps should be corrected or managed transparently before conclusions are accepted.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Complete the analysis using assumptions that are not identified in the record' does not apply the controlling principle for process safety information quality to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Treat operator memory as a permanent substitute for current drawings' does not apply the controlling principle for process safety information quality to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Remove reactivity scenarios so the review can finish on time' does not apply the controlling principle for process safety information quality to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.chapterTitle: Process Safety Management and Management of Change
questions.stem: A PHA lists “operator training” as the only safeguard for high-pressure runaway reaction. Which challenge is most important?
options: Accept training as independent of every equipment and procedural failure
Determine whether independent engineered prevention and mitigation layers are needed and whether the claimed safeguard has defined, verifiable performance
Delete the scenario because trained operators cannot make errors
Count each training topic as a separate independent protection layer
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: High-consequence scenarios usually require reliable, appropriately independent layers. Administrative controls should not be credited without realistic performance and assurance.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Accept training as independent of every equipment and procedural failure' does not apply the controlling principle for process hazard analysis safeguards to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Delete the scenario because trained operators cannot make errors' does not apply the controlling principle for process hazard analysis safeguards to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Count each training topic as a separate independent protection layer' does not apply the controlling principle for process hazard analysis safeguards to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: A PHA recommendation to install high-high shutdown protection remains open for three years, and production continues under an undocumented verbal agreement. What is the central deficiency?

Recommendations can remain open indefinitely if no incident occurs
Recommendations require timely documented resolution, communicated decisions, interim risk management, and completion tracking
A verbal acceptance is equivalent to documented risk resolution

The option 'Recommendations can remain open indefinitely if no incident occurs' does not apply the controlling principle for pha recommendation resolution to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'A verbal acceptance is equivalent to documented risk resolution' does not apply the controlling principle for pha recommendation resolution to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: Maintenance replaces a process valve with one having the same nominal size but a different trim material and failure position. Is MOC review warranted?
options: Only the purchasing department needs to approve material substitution
No; MOC applies only to changes in production rate
No; classify the valve as replacement-in-kind based on nominal pipe size without reviewing trim material or failure position
Yes; seemingly equivalent replacement can change compatibility, flow, fail-safe behavior, and process risk and should be screened under the MOC process

incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Only the purchasing department needs to approve material substitution' does not apply the controlling principle for management of change screening to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'No; MOC applies only to changes in production rate' does not apply the controlling principle for management of change screening to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'No; classify the valve as replacement-in-kind based on nominal pipe size without reviewing trim material or failure position' does not apply the controlling principle for management of change screening to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: A control logic change is approved and installed, but operating procedures, alarm response, drawings, and operator training are unchanged. What is missing?

Software changes do not affect process safety documentation
Only the programmer needs to understand the new alarm logic

questions.stem: A new covered process is mechanically complete, but relief-device documentation and operator training are incomplete. Management wants to introduce chemicals for a schedule milestone. What should happen?
options: Replace the pre-startup review with a management email accepting the schedule risk
Delay startup until the pre-startup review confirms construction, procedures, training, and safety systems are complete and appropriate
Start at reduced rate because incomplete safeguards matter only at full production
Introduce chemicals and finish documentation during operation

incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Replace the pre-startup review with a management email accepting the schedule risk' does not apply the controlling principle for pre-startup safety review to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Start at reduced rate because incomplete safeguards matter only at full production' does not apply the controlling principle for pre-startup safety review to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'Introduce chemicals and finish documentation during operation' does not apply the controlling principle for pre-startup safety review to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: Inspection finds thinning below the established minimum in a pressure boundary, but the unit can still operate at normal conditions for several weeks. What is the best response?
options: Increase operating pressure to confirm whether the component will fail
Continue indefinitely because no leak is visible
Evaluate fitness for service through competent engineering, control the risk, and repair or replace within a documented safe operating basis
Delete the minimum thickness from the inspection plan
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Mechanical integrity requires timely correction of equipment deficiencies or documented safe operation based on technical evaluation—not waiting for loss of containment.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Increase operating pressure to confirm whether the component will fail' does not apply the controlling principle for mechanical integrity and deficiency management to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Continue indefinitely because no leak is visible' does not apply the controlling principle for mechanical integrity and deficiency management to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Delete the minimum thickness from the inspection plan' does not apply the controlling principle for mechanical integrity and deficiency management to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
